scope: schematic preamp DC only; no CMRR, whole-comparator or extracted-layout claim

points.rule: highest temperature present; largest max(sig_dvos_dn_uv, sig_dvos_up_uv); ties by corner id

plan.hot_rule: highest temperature present; largest max(sig_dvos_dn_uv, sig_dvos_up_uv); ties by corner id

classification_rule: d_last = max |delta endpoint-minus-midpoint offset| between the last two profiles; d_all = the same between baseline and the last profile; both over all PVT points, draws and both endpoints. stable: d_last <= T and d_all <= T. tolerance-dominated: d_last <= T and d_all > T. inconclusive: d_last > T, too few draws/points, or no raw output changed between any two profiles (tolerance control not evidenced). A numerical reproducibility criterion, not a CMRR specification.
